question: What voltage did sensor 7.0 measure on 2004-03-01 at 03:35:16?
graph_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 7.0})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-03-01T03:35:16"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.voltage AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
